# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.55

Changes since version [0.0.54](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.54).

## Improved

- Folder tabs show their full path in an immediate tooltip styled with the active VS Code theme. The close hint is available in the tab context menu.

## Fixed

- The editor used by X-Ray and Quick Diff includes DOMPurify 3.4.17 to address known HTML sanitization vulnerabilities.

## Updating

Update Bitfroest.fs in the VS Code Extensions view on the pre-release channel. Supported packages target Windows x64 and Linux x64. The Apple Silicon package is experimental. macOS has no official support.
